items.en: Wall Street suffers worst day in 19 months as the chip index plunges 12.25%
items.zh: **美股四大指數全面重挫**，費半單日暴跌 12.25%，那斯達克跌 5.52% 正式進入修正區間。
items.summary: US stocks fell sharply on Thursday November 5. The Nasdaq Composite dropped 1,421.52 points, or 5.52%, to 24,315.00, its worst single session in nineteen months and enough to confirm a correction after an eleven percent slide over the past month. The S&P 500 lost 4.36% to 7,353.73, the Dow fell 1,833.06 points or 3.44% to 51,523.06, and the Russell 2000 shed 4.4%. The Philadelphia Semiconductor Index collapsed 12.25%, its steepest fall since March 2020. Money moved into Treasuries, pushing the ten-year yield down about six basis points to 4.83%, while gold rose and bitcoin fell roughly 5.4%.
items.source: 鉅亨網／世界日報（11/5 美股盤後）

items.en: Post-election data centre policy fears trigger the AI selloff
items.zh: **殺盤主因是 AI 政策風險**：民主黨期中選舉全勝後，多位新任州長主張嚴限資料中心興建，參議員桑德斯更喊全國暫停。
items.summary: Investors read the Democratic sweep of both chambers and five governorships as a turning point for AI infrastructure policy. Newly elected governors including Gina Hinojosa in Texas, Keisha Lance Bottoms in Georgia and Amy Acton in Ohio campaigned on strict conditions for large data centre projects, and several incoming senators want limits on construction and power supply. Senator Bernie Sanders called for a nationwide pause on data centre building, a political proposal rather than an enacted ban. A Meta executive also said building data centres would become harder. The Nasdaq lost about 2.5 trillion dollars of market value in one day.

items.en: Taiwan's TAIEX falls for a sixth straight day, down 1,374 points
items.summary: Taiwan's benchmark index closed on November 5 at 41,574.72, down 1,374.19 points or 3.2%, falling below 42,000 and marking a sixth consecutive decline. Turnover reached NT$926.0 billion. Foreign investors net sold about NT$102.5 billion, the tenth largest single-day outflow on record, and have now sold for six sessions running. The over-the-counter TPEx index fared far worse, dropping 22.03 points or 6.41% to 321.47, prompting the exchange to issue a statement urging investors not to panic. Memory and PCB names led the fall, with several hitting limit down, while textile stocks rose against the trend.
items.source: 鉅亨網／聯合新聞網（11/5 台股盤後）

items.en: COP31 climate summit opens in Antalya, Türkiye on November 9
items.zh: **COP31 氣候峰會 11/9–20 在土耳其安塔利亞登場**，焦點是各國能否補上過去承諾的減碳與氣候資金缺口。
items.summary: The thirty-first United Nations climate conference runs from November 9 to 20 in Antalya, Türkiye. Negotiators arrive with a credibility problem: the national climate plans submitted so far still point to warming well above the Paris Agreement's 1.5 degree goal, and the finance pledged to developing countries remains far short of what was promised at earlier summits. Expected flashpoints include the pace of the transition away from fossil fuels, rules for carbon markets, and who pays for adaptation and loss and damage. Delivery on existing commitments, rather than new headline targets, is the test observers say matters.

items.en: Vote counting continues in Alaska, Mississippi and Kansas after the Democratic sweep
items.zh: **期中選舉開票仍在收尾**：阿拉斯加、密西西比與堪薩斯仍在計票，民主黨已確定同時掌握參眾兩院。
items.summary: Counting continued in Alaska, Mississippi and Kansas several days after the November 3 midterms, though control of both chambers of Congress had already been decided for the Democrats. The result hands the party the House and the Senate alongside five governorships taken from Republicans, and analysts have framed it as a verdict on prices, health costs and tariffs. President Trump told CNBC he could work with Democrats on more issues than people expect. A divided government makes sweeping new legislation unlikely, which some investors read as lower policy risk even as AI regulation fears hit markets.

items.en: Apple puts five new products on sale today, including its first touchscreen MacBook Pro
items.zh: **蘋果今天（11/6）開賣五款新品**：OLED iPad mini、M6 iMac、M6 MacBook Pro，以及史上第一款 OLED 觸控 MacBook Pro 14／16 吋。
items.summary: Apple's five new products go on sale on Friday November 6, with pre-orders already open. The redesigned iPad mini starts at 699 dollars with an 8.5-inch OLED display, the A20 Pro chip, IP67 water resistance and a thinner body. A new iMac with the M6 chip starts at 1,499 dollars, and a spec-bumped 14-inch MacBook Pro with M6 starts at 1,999 dollars. The headline models are Apple's first touchscreen MacBook Pros, with OLED displays at 2,899 dollars for 14 inches and 3,399 dollars for 16 inches. Most pre-orders arrive on launch day, though Space Black touchscreen units slip three to four weeks.

items.en: OpenAI hires away Anthropic's Claude Code product lead
items.zh: **OpenAI 挖走 Anthropic 的 Claude Code 產品負責人 Cat Wu**，AI 寫程式工具的人才戰持續升溫。
items.summary: OpenAI has recruited Cat Wu, who led product for Anthropic's Claude Code, the command line coding agent that became one of the company's fastest growing products. The move continues an unusually aggressive run of hiring between the two largest frontier labs, concentrated on the people who ship developer tools rather than on researchers. Coding agents have turned into the most commercially proven application of large language models, and both firms are racing to own the workflow that developers keep open all day. Neither company commented in detail on what she will build at OpenAI.

items.en: Claude adds a personal finance feature with read-only bank access
items.zh: **Claude 新增個人理財功能**，可用唯讀方式連結銀行帳戶做支出分析，資料不會被寫入或動用。
items.summary: Anthropic is rolling out a personal finance capability in Claude that connects to a user's bank accounts in read-only mode. The assistant can then categorise spending, summarise cash flow and answer questions about a household budget without any ability to move money or change account settings. Read-only access is the key design choice: it limits the blast radius if the model misreads something, and it sidesteps the approval problem that has slowed agentic finance tools elsewhere. The feature puts Claude into direct competition with budgeting apps, and raises the usual questions about how long sensitive transaction data is retained.

items.en: Thunder hold off the Lakers at home as Los Angeles fades on the road
items.zh: **雷霆主場擊退湖人**，湖人客場後段跟不上節奏，衛冕軍開季手感依舊火燙。
items.summary: Oklahoma City beat the Los Angeles Lakers at home, with the Lakers unable to match the defending champions' pace once the game tightened in the second half. The Thunder have leaned on the same formula that carried them through last season: relentless ball pressure, a deep rotation and enough shot creation to survive stretches when the outside shots stop falling. For the Lakers the loss continued a pattern of road games decided in the final quarter. The result keeps Oklahoma City near the top of the Western Conference standings in the early weeks of the season.

items.en: Milwaukee Brewers win the first World Series title in franchise history
items.zh: **釀酒人拿下隊史首座世界大賽冠軍**，結束球團五十多年的等待，2026 季後賽正式落幕。
items.summary: The Milwaukee Brewers won the 2026 World Series, the first championship in a franchise history stretching back to 1969 and the end of one of baseball's longest title droughts. Milwaukee reached the series as the best regular season team in the National League and carried that form through October, winning with pitching depth and a lineup that produced without a single superstar bat. The win leaves only a handful of clubs still without a World Series trophy. Attention now turns to a free agent market that several contenders are expected to attack aggressively.

items.en: Japanese media grade the 2026 MLB season: Ohtani an A, Suzuki an S
items.zh: **日媒評 2026 年大聯盟日籍球員**：鈴木誠也拿到最高的 S，大谷翔平只拿 A，投打二刀流負荷被點名。
items.summary: Japanese media published season grades for Japanese players in Major League Baseball in 2026, giving Seiya Suzuki the top S rating and Shohei Ohtani an A. Suzuki's grade reflects a full healthy season and production that held up through the summer, while the assessment of Ohtani focused on the cost of carrying both a pitching and a hitting workload, which trimmed his numbers at the plate relative to his best years. The exercise is as much a commentary on usage as on talent, and feeds a long running debate in Japan about how long the two-way role is sustainable.

items.en: Lawsuit says a Google AI tool used in school triggered a teenager's mental health crisis
items.zh: **美國家庭提告**：校內使用的 Google AI 工具被指引發青少年心理危機，學校導入 AI 的責任界線成焦點。
items.summary: A lawsuit filed in the United States alleges that a Google artificial intelligence tool used in a school setting contributed to a teenager's mental health crisis. The case matters less for its specific claims than for the question it forces: when a district deploys a general purpose AI system to students, who carries responsibility for how the model responds to a child in distress. Schools have adopted these tools quickly, often without the safeguarding review applied to counselling services. Expect the filing to be cited in arguments for clearer duty of care standards on educational AI.

items.en: Scientists warn permanent daylight saving time carries a hidden cost
items.zh: **永久日光節約時間有副作用**：研究指出長期把時鐘往後撥會讓生理時鐘與日照長期錯位，影響睡眠與學習表現。
items.summary: Researchers warn that making daylight saving time permanent would leave clock time chronically misaligned with the solar day, pushing sunrise later in winter mornings. The concern is circadian: light in the early morning is what anchors the body clock, and removing it is associated with shorter sleep, later bedtimes and worse alertness, with adolescents the most exposed because school start times are fixed. The scientists argue permanent standard time fits human physiology better than permanent daylight saving, even though the latter is more politically popular for its late summer evenings.

items.en: Psychologists petition the APA to create a psychedelic science division
items.zh: **心理學界推動成立迷幻科學分支**，向美國心理學會請願設立專門部門，反映臨床研究已成主流議題。
items.summary: A group of psychologists has petitioned the American Psychological Association to create a division dedicated to psychedelic science. Supporters argue the field has outgrown its position at the margins: clinical trials of psilocybin and MDMA assisted therapy now run at major universities, and practitioners need professional standards, training pathways and ethics guidance that no existing division owns. A dedicated division would also give the work institutional legitimacy inside the largest body of American psychologists. Critics inside the profession caution that evidence for durable benefit remains thinner than public enthusiasm suggests.

items.en: Chip stocks post historic losses: Micron down 17%, AMD down 17%, SanDisk down 22%
items.zh: **半導體股歷史性重挫**：美光 −17.46%、AMD −17.26%、SanDisk −22.26%、SK海力士 ADR −13.40%、台積電 ADR −10.78%。
items.summary: The semiconductor selloff on November 5 was broad and violent. Micron fell 17.46%, AMD 17.26% and SanDisk 22.26%, with SK Hynix's ADR down 13.40% and TSMC's ADR down 10.78%. Nvidia lost 9.26%, erasing roughly 447 billion dollars of market value in a single session. Qualcomm fell about 9.5% after reporting weaker smartphone chip sales and margins squeezed by rising memory costs, and Arm's 27% revenue growth still missed the most optimistic outlooks. Dell dropped 15% and CoreWeave 9.8%. Analysts expect volatility-driven funds to sell roughly 135 billion dollars of US equity futures over the next day or two.

items.en: Memory makers lead Taiwan's rout with multiple limit-down closes
items.zh: **台股記憶體與 PCB 族群跌停**：南亞科、華邦電雙雙跌停，日月光 −8.77%、旺宏 −8.60%、台光電與金像電跌停。
items.summary: Taiwan's memory and PCB groups absorbed the worst of the November 5 selling. Nanya Technology and Winbond both closed limit down at 9.89%, at NT$360 and NT$127.5 respectively, while Macronix fell 8.60% and Elite Semiconductor 7.56%. ASE Technology dropped 8.77% and Delta Electronics 7.38%, the latter caught by the same data centre policy fears hitting US power names. In copper clad laminate and PCB, Elite Material closed limit down at NT$4,100 and Career Technology at NT$868. MediaTek fell 6.86% to NT$3,460 while TSMC held up far better at a 0.88% decline.

items.en: Claude's user base grows 1,260% but ChatGPT still leads by a wide margin
items.zh: **Claude 一年成長 1,260%**，但 ChatGPT 仍穩居第一，Gemini 則靠 Google 生態系緊追。
items.summary: App analytics from Sensor Tower show Claude growing about 1,260% year on year, the fastest expansion among the major consumer AI assistants, while ChatGPT remains comfortably the largest by downloads and active users. Gemini sits between them, boosted less by standalone app installs than by distribution through Google's existing products. The pattern suggests the consumer assistant market is still widening rather than consolidating: rapid percentage growth from a smaller base has not yet dented the incumbent's lead. Enterprise and developer revenue, where Anthropic is strongest, is not captured by these figures at all.

items.en: Kenshi Yonezu's 2026 TOUR / GHOST opens tonight in Nagano
items.zh: **米津玄師「2026 TOUR / GHOST」今天 11/6（五）長野 Big Hat 開跑**，日本 6 城 14 場到 12/17 橫濱；**台北大巨蛋 12/26–27**。　▶ **Spotify**：https://open.spotify.com/search/%E7%B1%B3%E6%B4%A5%E7%8E%84%E5%B8%AB
items.summary: Kenshi Yonezu's arena tour 2026 TOUR / GHOST opens on Friday November 6 at Nagano Big Hat, the first of fourteen shows across six Japanese cities. The run takes in K-Arena Yokohama on November 11 and 12, Osaka-jo Hall on the 18th and 19th, Marine Messe Fukuoka on the 27th and 28th, Sendai's Sekisui Heim Super Arena in early December and Portmesse Nagoya on December 8 and 9, before closing with two nights back at K-Arena Yokohama on December 16 and 17. Reserved seats are 9,900 yen. The overseas leg brings him to Taipei Dome on December 26 and 27.

items.en: YOASOBI sell out two Taipei Dome nights, about 70,000 tickets gone at once
items.zh: **YOASOBI 2027 年 1 月台北大巨蛋 2 天**，約 7 萬張票開賣即完售，是台灣場規模最大的一次。　▶ **Spotify**：https://open.spotify.com/search/YOASOBI
items.summary: YOASOBI will play two nights at Taipei Dome in January 2027, and the roughly seventy thousand tickets across both shows sold out almost immediately. The scale is a step up from the group's earlier Taiwan appearances at arena-sized venues, and puts them among the small number of Japanese acts who can fill a dome outside Japan. The dates sit inside the same world tour cycle that has been running through Asia this year. Fans who missed out are watching for resale arrangements and for whether a third date gets added.

items.en: King Gnu announce their first headline US tour for 2027
items.zh: **King Gnu 宣布 2027 年首度美國巡演**，接在史上最大規模亞洲巡迴 15 城 29 場之後。　▶ **Spotify**：https://open.spotify.com/search/King%20Gnu
items.summary: King Gnu have announced their first headline tour of the United States, scheduled for 2027. It follows the band's largest Asian tour to date, a twenty-nine show run across fifteen cities, and continues a steady widening of their touring map rather than a one-off festival appearance. The band has also been unusually relaxed about phone filming at recent shows, saying they do not actively encourage it but will allow photography and recording during the new tour, a policy that has helped their live clips spread outside Japan.

items.en: Aimer announces a national hall tour starting next September
items.zh: **Aimer 宣布明年 9 月起全國 Hall 巡迴**，場館型巡演規模，台港場次尚未公布。　▶ **Spotify**：https://open.spotify.com/search/Aimer
items.summary: Aimer has announced a national hall tour in Japan beginning next September. Hall venues rather than arenas suit the detail in her live arrangements, and the long lead time gives room for a release to land before the tour starts. No Taiwan or Hong Kong dates have been announced yet, which for an artist with a sizeable following across Chinese-speaking Asia usually means an overseas leg is decided later. Ticket priority is expected to run through her fan club first, as on previous tours.
